question: What specific capacity in mAh/g did the strained V2O5 films deliver?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%mAh%' OR text ILIKE '%capacity%' OR text ILIKE '%mAh/g%' OR text ILIKE '%mAh g%' ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, page, text FROM sentences WHERE text ILIKE '%capacity%' OR text ILIKE '%mAh%' OR text ILIKE '%specific%'

SELECT 'ocr' k, figure_id, text FROM figure_ocr WHERE text ILIKE '%mAh%' OR text ILIKE '%capacit%' OR text ILIKE '%g-1%' OR text ILIKE '%mA%' UNION ALL SELECT 'fact', figure_id, statement FROM figure_facts WHERE statement ILIKE '%mAh%' OR statement ILIKE '%capacit%' OR statement ILIKE '%specific%'

SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE text ILIKE '%charge%' OR text ILIKE '%discharge%' OR text ILIKE '%mAh%' OR text ILIKE '%galvano%' OR text ILIKE '%battery%' OR text ILIKE '%batter%' ORDER BY page, line_no

SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page IN (4,5,6) AND (line_no BETWEEN 25 AND 40 OR text ILIKE '%galvano%' OR text ILIKE '%g−1%' OR text ILIKE '%g-1%' OR text ILIKE '%mA%' OR text ILIKE '%capacit%' OR text ILIKE '%specific%') ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, figure_id, statement FROM figure_facts WHERE figure_id IN ('p5.F4','p5.F5') OR statement ILIKE '%charge%' OR statement ILIKE '%current%'
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE (page=6 AND line_no>=125) OR (page=7 AND line_no<=20) ORDER BY page, line_no
SELECT id, kind, page, text FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%mah%' OR text ILIKE '%capacit%' OR text ILIKE '%g−1%' OR text ILIKE '%g-1%'

runs.text: The document does not report a specific capacity in mAh/g for the strained V2O5 films. It contains no capacity values in mAh/g. The electrochemical results are given as
cyclic voltammograms and galvanostatic charge-discharge curves

for the unstrained and strained states, along with peak currents, diffusion coefficients and Li+ intercalation energies, but no capacity figure is stated. The term mAh is absent from the text, figures and figure readings.
